description: This file implements a Linux-specific launcher class for the Cobalt project, providing process control, signaling, and environment management functionalities.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching and managing Cobalt tools on Linux, including process control, signaling, and environment setup.

methods.name: GetProcessStatus
methods.description: Returns the running status of a process given its PID.

methods.name: Launcher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the launcher with platform, target, configuration, and device ID, setting up environment and executable path.

methods.name: Launcher.Run
methods.description: Runs the launcher executable as a subprocess and waits for completion.

methods.name: Launcher.Kill
methods.description: Kills the running process if it exists.

methods.name: Launcher.SupportsSuspendResume
methods.description: Indicates support for suspend and resume operations.

methods.name: Launcher.SendResume
methods.description: Sends a continue signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendSuspend
methods.description: Sends a suspend signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendConceal
methods.description: Sends a conceal signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendFocus
methods.description: Sends a focus (continue) signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendFreeze
methods.description: Sends a freeze (stop) signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendStop
methods.description: Sends a stop signal to the process.

methods.name: Launcher.SendDeepLink
methods.description: Attempts to send a deep link to the process, with retries.

methods.name: Launcher.WaitForProcessStatus
methods.description: Waits for the process to reach a specified status within a timeout.

methods.name: Launcher.GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Returns the path for output files.

methods.name: Launcher.IgnoreAsanLeaks
methods.description: Modifies environment variables to disable leak detection in AddressSanitizer.
